shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: sky level above, solid rock basement below, fully simulated linked maps with live see-through air, cross-level work/hauling/medical/power/pipes/climate, stairs/ladders/elevators, one-colony UI.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level with a live view of the surface below; (2) performance via caching, event-driven work, and zero recurring cost when idle.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only. DBH + VEF PipeSystem soft compat (typed bridges, clean signatures); Reverse Commands soft compat (reflection-only, zero typerefs).
- Cap: 3 levels per column. Basement solid mineable rock, thick-roofed, 12C.
- Animal policy (conservative): pets follow master, obedient pets get send gizmos, non-pen unrestricted pets cross for food; pen animals never.
- Robustness: ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only. Modern Suite parity contract for any styled UI.

## Vertical transport
- Stairs (1x), ladder (1.6x), grand staircase 2x2 (0.6x, quality scales climb), elevator (0.35x, power bridge, Extend shaft gizmos, two-hop rides auto-continue).
- Climb = 90t x type x quality x settings slider. All minifiable (uninstall collapses the far side). Bomb >= 40 punches constructed rooftops.
- Consumers resolve links via CounterpartTowards(map); stair jobs carry their exit in targetC. Giddy-Up mounted riders blocked with dismount message.
- Stairs do NOT unroof anything below (user decision). Sky-side landing platforms (footprint+1) are RoofSurface, exempt from air-reversion while their stairs stand (IsStairsPlatform), reverting once destroyed.

## Sky surface model (round-5 spec 2026-07-19)
- Two owned terrains: AB_OpenAir (see-through, impassable) and AB_RoofSurface (corrugated steel rooftop; muted vanilla-toned 512px texture, low-contrast ribs, no rivets).
- COVERED-BELOW rule (single predicate LevelSync.CoveredBelow, used by genstep + live events + sweep): constructed roof below = rooftop, OR artificial impassable edifice below (wall/door, not mineable/rock/stairs) supporting an adjacent constructed roof - the steel runs to the OUTER edge of the wall blocks (playtest ask). Natural roofs are generation-time only (rim = vanilla rough stone of the local rock). Wall-only changes (no roof event) converge via the 2000t sweep; roof events also re-sync the 8 neighbors so wall tops promote/demote live.
- Mountains: mass erodes one step to a walkable unfogged LEDGE ring; wall core = solid rock + thick rock roof everywhere; fog ONLY where all walls within radius 2 (deep interior) - fogging the faces let the fog edge swallow the ledge (round-4 regression, reverted). Rim + mass terrain use the rock's naturalTerrain; ore lumps in the mass.
- Sync self-heal: subscription retry (250t) + ReconcileRooftops (FinalizeInit + 2000t), both platform-exempt, both CoveredBelow-driven.

## See-below renderer (final architecture)
- Static pass: lower map's section meshes drawn through cloned materials in a queue band derived at RUNTIME from a real terrain material (guessed constants failed twice). Band: terrain -300 ... things -200 + altitude step ... overlays -80 under the measured ceiling; every sky material draws over the below view.
- Dynamic pass: ONE-WAY MIRROR - a below thing draws only if unroofed (any roof), unfogged, in view, and under open air. Filtered per-thing loop (DynamicDrawPhase(Draw), mirrors vanilla singleThreadedDrawing path) with reflection fallback to the unfiltered pass.
- Air-cells light mask (night cap 0.45) on FogOfWar queue over air cells only; silhouettes suppressed; ceiling hints; far clip 70. Weather decider suppressed on pocket levels; surface sync sole driver.

## Systems (T0-T10 verified in-game 2026-07-19)
- Logistics: outbound haul + inbound fetch + demand pull (construction, bill shortfalls, patient/prisoner meals) + export pinning + deterministic carried-cargo delivery.
- Column-aware stuff picker (pattern-guarded transpiler + ResourceCounter augmentation).
- Needs: rest to owned bed anywhere in column or free bed on linked level; food redirect incl. eligible pets. Medical rescue WorkGiver + capture float order via CarriedIntent.
- One-colony UI: tables append other levels (ghouls in Schedule only; Fluffy Animal Tab via RecachePawns); colonist bar ordered sky/surface/basement; level buttons in global controls (Declutter bypass); camera preserves view; beds alert aggregates.
- Power/pipes/climate bridge per link; ABPendingOrders replay; ABOreGen (6/10k cells, commonality-weighted, modded ores included).

## Performance architecture
- ABGuard plain-bool switches; AnySkyLevels static gate; NearestUsableStairsCached per-tick memo; shared stairs helpers; small caches. Recurring: weather 150t, pipes/climate 250t, power 10t hash, rooftop sweep 2000t. Zero recurring cost with no levels.

## Compat
- DBH + VEF bridges; Reverse Commands; Fluffy Animal Tab; Declutter UI; Giddy-Up; incompatibleWith MultiFloors + ZLevels1.1; RimThreaded unsupported; foreign pocket maps read as level-0.

## Documented accepted limitations
- Floating rim/ledge rock on natural roof loss (rare); sky projectile dim over air; tall below-sprites clip at rooftop edges; wall-only edits converge on the sweep cadence (<=33s); bill radius vs stairs delivery; couples as singles in beds alert; RC direct links only; restaurants per-level; stuff picker direct links only.
- Threat policy: pocket levels raid-free; opt-ins slated for T8.

## Tranche plan
- T0-T10 DONE. Optimization + compat pass DONE. Playtest rounds 2-5 DONE (2026-07-19): stuff picker, ore gen, retry+sweep, queue-band renderer, one-way mirror, wall-edge rooftop rule, muted texture, mountain fog regression reverted (ledge restored). Pending relaunch verification of round 5.
- Next: T5 publishing prep. Backlog: T8 threat opt-ins, T9 pipe depth, T11 world integration.

## Status
Round-5 fixes implemented and compiling. Awaiting relaunch verification, then T5 publishing prep.
